Module Contents¶

nvitk.measure.morpho.orchestration.process_component_tree_vmtk(label: int, component_id: int, mask_cc: numpy.ndarray, multilabel: numpy.ndarray, spacing, vessel_info: nvitk.measure.morpho.models.VesselInfo, mapping: dict, centerline_dir: str | None, centerline_radius_dir: str | None, region_centerline_dir: str | None, surface_dir: str | None, ctx: nvitk.measure.morpho.anatomy_axes.MorphoContext | None = None) → Tuple[List[dict], Dict[str, pandas.DataFrame], dict, pandas.DataFrame, List[dict], Dict[str, pandas.DataFrame], List[dict], pandas.DataFrame, List[dict]]¶

Full per-component morphometrics pipeline: skeletonize → VMTK centerlines → metrics/export.

Drives, for one connected component of one label: skeleton extraction and root selection, surface reconstruction, VMTK centerline generation between root and each terminal (with donut-loop handling and retry logic), stenosis/ enlargement detection, recursive tree-segment splitting, and every VTP/point export. This is the single entry point run_case dispatches to workers.

Returns:

(path_results, point_sheets, tree_summary, branch_df, region_summaries, region_sheets, recursive_segments, donut_loop_df, split_results) — see the call sites in run_case for how each piece feeds the exported workbook. path_results are the measured root→terminal paths, which overlap on shared trunks; split_results is the non-overlapping representation the workbook summarises.

Return type:

tuple
